meta.description: Registry for operator composition failure modes in Phase 2 of the Mono-Process Formal Law Program.

failure_modes.name: codomain_domain_mismatch
failure_modes.description: The output class of the first operator is incompatible with the required input class of the second operator.

failure_modes.name: non_associative_composition
failure_modes.description: The result of (A ∘ B) ∘ C differs from A ∘ (B ∘ C) under declared conditions.

failure_modes.name: non_commuting_order_error
failure_modes.description: Operators are treated as interchangeable when order sensitivity is present.

failure_modes.name: projection_order_instability
failure_modes.description: The sequence of admissibility projections affects the final stability or membership of the process state.

failure_modes.name: residue_order_drift
failure_modes.description: Operator order results in unintended divergence or drift in the residue state.

failure_modes.name: branch_pruning_selection_conflict
failure_modes.description: Composition of pruning and selection leads to an empty or degenerate continuation set.

failure_modes.name: orientation_metric_order_conflict
failure_modes.description: Changing the order of orientation minimization and other operations destabilizes the orientation frame.

failure_modes.name: composition_closure_failure
failure_modes.description: The composite operator fails to satisfy closure conditions within the expected codomain.

failure_modes.name: undefined_intermediate_object
failure_modes.description: Composition produces a state or object that has no formal class registration.
